lines.zh: 我的爪子刨开一层碎石
lines.en: My claws scoop away a layer of gravel

lines.zh: 我的翅膀折着，像两片岩
lines.en: My wings fold like two slabs of rock.

lines.zh: 在滴水石洞里，我走得很慢
lines.en: In the dripstone caves I move slowly.
The ceiling is low; I keep my head down.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在洞里拖出声
lines.en: My tail drags noisily in the cave.

lines.zh: 每一步都让碎石滑一下
lines.en: Every step makes rubble slide.
I skirt around a stalagmite.
Every step, gravel slides down beneath me

lines.zh: 在沙漠里，我反而走得快
lines.en: In the desert I move faster.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓着干裂的土
lines.en: My claws grip the cracked earth.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞壁走，避开深处
lines.en: I keep to the cave wall, away from the depths.
The depths are too dark. I dislike them.
Turning, my shoulder scrapes the stone.
These claws are made for digging.
I lie on the cave floor, motionless.

lines.zh: 背上的甲片透着一点红
lines.en: A faint red shows through my back plates.
I listen to the dripping water.
Sulfur and stone dust in the air.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后轻轻摆
lines.en: My tail sways gently behind me.
I coil near my anchor.
Wind outside, none in here.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，听了一下
lines.en: I raise my head and listen.
The pillar's shadow is long.
I wait for something to enter the cave.
My plates cool slowly.
Cooler is better, actually.
I press my body back to the floor.
Then I'll wait for now.
I size you up from behind a stalagmite.
You stand in the cave mouth, backlit.

lines.zh: 我的甲片比你的护甲厚
lines.en: My plates are thicker than your armour.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀折着，但能张开
lines.en: My wings are folded, but they open.

lines.zh: 你走近了，洞里的声音变了
lines.en: You came closer; the cave's sound changed.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋从地面抬起来
lines.en: I lift my head off the ground.
The ceiling is low. You can't retreat far.
I know this place well.
Do you dig as well?

lines.zh: 我可以教你，也可以不理
lines.en: I could teach you, or ignore you.
I haven't decided yet.
You stand there waiting.
Then I'll give you an answer.

lines.zh: 我从石笋后探出半个头
lines.en: I poke half my head out from the stalagmite
This is only preparation.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿一直没退开
lines.en: You've stood there and not stepped back.
A chunk cracks off my plate.
I press down even lower.
Dust from the ceiling settles on my back.
I growl; the echo is loud.
One wing won't move well.
I shrink back behind the pillar.
A plate cracked; I slowed down.
You pulled back again. Good.
There's a long way left in this cave.
I'm not about to yield.
That thing doesn't go in my mouth.
But I know its material.

lines.zh: 我这两条铲子似的手，先拱开土。
lines.en: My shovel hands dig through the soil first.

lines.zh: 那东西的硬度，我闻得出
lines.en: I can smell how hard that thing is
I scrape it with a claw tip.
Stone, or metal.
This looks diggable.

lines.zh: 我的翅根一合，它就归我
lines.en: My wing roots close and it is mine
Go back to the cave mouth.
It belongs to me now.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经攥住它了
lines.en: My claws have already closed on it
Look if you like. Don't reach.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，洞里有回音
lines.en: You hit me; it echoes in the cave.
My body barely shifts.
A few stones drop from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我的翅膀弹开一下
lines.en: That made my wing flick open.
I fold it back.
You back off, boots slipping on stone.
Dust rises in the cave.
Don't press at the base of my wings.
That's the most fragile spot.
I don't like anyone knowing that.

lines.zh: 我这么大的身子，没有同类
lines.en: A body this big, and no kin of mine
We each hold a stretch of tunnel.
Meeting, we give way.
My anchor is by the pillar.
That tunnel leads down. It's warm.
You lead; I'll take the rear.
If something comes, I block the tunnel.
I'm wide enough.
Echoes are loud in here. Don't shout.
A nudge will do instead of words.
I dig it out with a claw.
It's stuck in a crack.
One hard lever and it's out.
This can dig deeper tunnels.
You dropped it on the cave floor.
I tuck it under my wing.
Too heavy. I push it.
I push it behind the pillar.
I'll come move it later.
Useless things go into a crack.
You've walked into my tunnel.
I turn my body around.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开一半，卡着洞壁
lines.en: I half-open my wings against the walls.
It's narrow here. You can't dodge.
My claws dig into the rock seam.

lines.zh: 这一扑会把你压在壁上
lines.en: This lunge will pin you to the wall.
You retreat; I squeeze after.
My plates are harder than the stone.
What you hold won't stop this.
There's a dead end ahead.
I'm quite sure of that.
Here I come. Don't look back.
I follow you through the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声在石壁间撞
lines.en: My breathing bounces off the walls.
You hear it, but you can't dodge.
This tunnel runs one way.
You can only keep going forward.
The ceiling drops further ahead.
There you'll have to stoop.
Then you can't get away.
The cave is too narrow for you to sidestep

lines.zh: 我的甲片擦过石壁，冒火星
lines.en: My plates scrape the wall and throw sparks

lines.zh: 地龙兽的爪，再走几步就到。
lines.en: A few more steps of these claws.
Now it's my turn to move.
My claw strikes your back.

lines.zh: 我的爪把你钉进碎石里
lines.en: My claw pins you into the rubble
My headbutt lands on your chest.

lines.zh: 洞顶被我们撞落几块石头
lines.en: We knock stones from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扫开你的武器
lines.en: My wing sweeps your weapon aside.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在石头上刮出响
lines.en: Your armour scrapes loudly on stone.

lines.zh: 我压低身子又冲了一次
lines.en: I lower myself and charge again.
No room to dodge in here.
The tunnel walls help me.
You're squeezed into the corner.
This blow gets it done.
It's over here.

lines.zh: 我从深暗的洞里爬上来
lines.en: I crawl up out of the deep dark.
My shape shows on the cave wall.
Wings folded, I pass the narrow spots.
Two or three of us came.
I settle by the stone pillar.
Water drips steadily in here.

lines.zh: 我的甲片还带着地下的凉
lines.en: My plates still carry the underground chill.
I raise my head and listen outside.
Wind, and something else.
I turn slowly to the cave mouth.
My claws scrape once.
I'll wait right here.

lines.zh: 洞道里只有我的呼吸声
lines.en: Only my breathing fills the tunnel.
The ceiling is low, so I have to crouch
Firelight fills the whole tunnel.

lines.zh: 我从洞壁摔下，砸在石堆上
lines.en: I fall from the wall onto a pile of stone.
Water floods the cave and I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把洞道里的石头全掀起来
lines.en: The blast throws up every stone in the tunnel.
An arrow sticks by the base of my wing.
That light circles once in the cave.
Too starved to spread my wings.

lines.zh: 雷打进洞里，我整具身子一颤
lines.en: Lightning enters the cave and my whole body jolts.
The cave floor is gone. I fall.
